purpose: Lock the reusable Monster Master RPG character, environment, prop, and interface visual language before producing the full P0 family catalog.

auditFindings.terrainPilot: accepted-and-reproducible; do not regenerate for this batch

tacticalUnitRenderer.directionPolicy: single mirror-safe field image in the current renderer

auditFindings.rpgShell: text-only event presentation; source masters may be produced now, but portrait and scene runtime integration requires a later media-presentation slice
auditFindings.terrainBuildScript: terrain-specific; do not reuse it as the portrait, token, prop, or scene derivative pipeline

styleInvariants: late-1990s or early-2000s hand-illustrated fantasy PC-game character
painted, inked, cel, scanned, or gouache-like surface treatment
clear silhouettes and restrained palettes at actual display size
practical lived-in fantasy society rather than generic heroic cosplay
room for slapstick, sincere stakes, and bounded horror without making every design a joke
original designs with no direct imitation of protected creature-battling franchises
globalRejects: uncontrolled spikes, armor clutter, or microdetail
text, logos, watermarks, labels, or baked interface
incident-specific clues or characters baked into reusable environments
opaque background where alpha or clean masking is required
strong fixed cast shadows that conflict with scene lighting
cropped feet or uncertain contact point on field tokens
one identical face reused for an entire portrait family

portrait.framing: waist-up or bust, three-quarter view, complete head and shoulders, generous crop safety
portrait.background: transparent preferred; otherwise flat neutral separation background suitable for masking
portrait.lighting: soft upper-left key with restrained fill

fieldToken.framing: full body, three-quarter downward view, feet and contact shadow fully visible

environment.framing: wide establishing composition with important information inside the central 70 percent
environment.characterPolicy: no named or incident-specific characters in reusable masters

prop.framing: single isolated object or deliberately separated modular set

interface.preferredSource: svg for geometry, icons, masks, and frames; raster material only when tactile texture is needed
requirements: readable on desktop, short desktop, mobile, and Discord Activity layouts
no debug or asset-generation language in player-facing presentation

batches.acceptanceRule: Do not expand every portrait family until these sources establish a coherent character language at 512-pixel card review size and 94-pixel token simulation size.

jobs.notes: Build as semantic HTML/CSS plus SVG ornament; do not make a flattened image the only source.
Fallbacks must feel intentional rather than like missing-art placeholders.
Lock identity only after comparing three materially different concepts. Pell must read as competent and recurring, not as a generic wizard, soldier, or disposable joke.
First service-worker identity. It must remain usable as an equipment clerk or practical local worker without becoming one fixed personality.
Second visibly distinct service-worker identity. This is the prepared cook or lunch-lady coverage, not a caricature and not the same face with a different hat.

batches.acceptanceRule: Approve only if the three masters feel like the same region while supporting materially different plot families and neutral scene composition.

deliverables: composition notes for busy and obstructed variants
composition notes for checkpoint, work-zone, and public-event overlays

batches.acceptanceRule: Approve only if props read at 128 pixels and UI remains usable without decorative assets.

jobs.notes: No readable text in the raster source; symbols and labels belong in GameFrame overlays.
Original Monster Master capture technology; no direct replication of protected franchise ball or device designs.

nextQueueAfterStyleLock: two candidate-rival identities and field tokens
two care-handler identities and field tokens
two guard-patrol identities and field tokens
supply cart, field kit, barrier, and license-case props
investigation, behavior-warning, hazard, objectives, and aftermath treatments
acceptanceEvidence: source master retained with prompt or authoring notes and rights provenance
clean crop, alpha, and contact point where applicable
comparison sheet at actual GameFrame review sizes
no copied franchise identity, unwanted text, watermark, or baked UI
consistent sibling palette, lighting, line treatment, and material scale
desktop, short-desktop, mobile, and Discord-safe crop review for scenes and interface
94-pixel tactical simulation and occlusion review for field tokens
explicit accepted, rejected, or repair decision recorded before expansion
blockedUntilConsumerExists: final portrait atlas or runtime bundle schema
RPG shell portrait and scene rendering hooks
